x: Enables a Matter-enabled Game Object to set its Body. Should be used as a mixin and not directly.

m.x: Set this Game Object to create and use a new Body based on the configuration object given.Calling this method resets all previous properties you may have set on the body, includingplugins, mass, friction, collision categories, etc. So be sure to re-apply these as needed.

p.x: Either a string, such as `circle`, or a Matter Set Body Configuration object.
An optional Body configuration object that is used to set initial Body properties on creation.

m.x: Set this Game Object's Matter physics body to be a circle shape.Calling this method resets all previous properties you may have set on the body, includingplugins, mass, friction, collision categories, etc. So be sure to re-apply these as needed.

p.x: An optional Body configuration object that is used to set initial Body properties on creation.

m.x: Set this Game Object to use the given existing Matter Body.The body is first removed from the world before being added to this Game Object.

p.x: The Body this Game Object should use.
Should the body be immediately added to the World?

m.x: Set this Game Object's Matter physics body to be a polygon shape.Calling this method resets all previous properties you may have set on the body, includingplugins, mass, friction, collision categories, etc. So be sure to re-apply these as needed.

p.x: The "radius" of the polygon, i.e. the distance from its center to any vertex. This is also the radius of its circumcircle.
The number of sides the polygon will have.
An optional Body configuration object that is used to set initial Body properties on creation.

m.x: Set this Game Object's Matter physics body to be a rectangle shape.Calling this method resets all previous properties you may have set on the body, includingplugins, mass, friction, collision categories, etc. So be sure to re-apply these as needed.

p.x: An optional Body configuration object that is used to set initial Body properties on creation.

m.x: Set this Game Object's Matter physics body to be a trapezoid shape.Calling this method resets all previous properties you may have set on the body, includingplugins, mass, friction, collision categories, etc. So be sure to re-apply these as needed.

p.x: The width of the trapezoid Body.
The height of the trapezoid Body.
The slope of the trapezoid. 0 creates a rectangle, while 1 creates a triangle. Positive values make the top side shorter, while negative values make the bottom side shorter.
An optional Body configuration object that is used to set initial Body properties on creation.
